thesis: Sizing equity ~$999.76 with $750.02 cash (75%) and a single VTI line at $249.74 (~25%) is still under-deployed for an aggressive mandate; prior 09:30/10:00 semis and QQQ legs did not land on the shared book, so the only live exposure remains broad beta in VTI. This tick adds one fresh macro headline versus 10:00: MarketWatch (14:00Z) reports U.S. junk bonds on track for their worst month since 2022 amid a global selloff — that is credit-stress context, not a tradable single-name signal, and it reinforces Mike Wilson’s earlier framing (11:03Z) favoring large-cap quality over riskier credit beta. Regime signals remain mildly supportive of equities at the margin: VIX 15.89 (-1.12%), WTI -1.63% and USO -2.10%, while the 10Y at 5.255% (+0.29%) keeps rate/multiple risk on the table. The SEC feed is still mostly routine 8-K noise; Carnival’s Item 2.02 filing is an earnings event I will not size without the filing body, and Novo’s licensing headline is company-specific but not a high-conviction chase at this bucket. I propose $150 QQQ as the quality large-cap/tech expression (consistent with TSMC U.S. expansion and semis narrative in the pack, without naming a single chip stock) and $75 VTI to continue the line that cleared consensus on 2026-09-28 while respecting the shared 35% name cap: post-fill VTI ~$325 (~32.5%), QQQ ~$150 (~15%), cash ~$525 (~52.5%), 2 of 6 positions — all above the 15% cash floor. I am not proposing VIX/vol products, futures, or micro-cap 8-K names. Propose only; consensus median sizing and book validation decide execution, and I assume no fills.
